new_source='''def transform(grid):
    """Extend each diagonal pair of equal foreground cells in both directions."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    background = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background:
                continue
            for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
                r2, c2 = r + dr, c + dc
                if not (0 <= r2 < h and 0 <= c2 < w) or grid[r2][c2] != color:
                    continue
                # Extend beyond both ends of this adjacent diagonal pair.
                for row, col, sr, sc in ((r - dr, c - dc, -dr, -dc),
                                         (r2 + dr, c2 + dc, dr, dc)):
                    while 0 <= row < h and 0 <= col < w and grid[row][col] == background:
                        out[row][col] = color
                        row += sr
                        col += sc
    return out
'''
